title: Term Life Insurance Renewal, Coverage Expiry and Rider End Dates
content:
Each Term Life Insurance tier is guaranteed renewable without evidence until the policy anniversary on or after the insured's attained age reaches the product's coverage expiry age, when coverage expires without value.

**Premium rate guarantee.** The premium rate per 1,000 is guaranteed for the product's premium guarantee period from the issue date. From the first anniversary after that period, and on every anniversary of the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term, the rate is re-set to the guaranteed attained-age renewal rate.

**Rider end dates.** The waiver of premium rider ends on the anniversary at the product's waiver rider expiry age and the accidental death benefit rider on the anniversary at the product's accidental death rider expiry age; their charges stop from the next installment due.

| Event | When it happens |
|---|---|
| Coverage expiry | The anniversary on or after the insured reaches the coverage expiry age |
| Rate re-set on a level term tier | From the first anniversary after the premium guarantee period, then each anniversary |
| Rate re-set on the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term | Every anniversary |
| Waiver of premium rider ends | The anniversary at the waiver rider expiry age |
| Accidental death benefit rider ends | The anniversary at the accidental death rider expiry age |
| Rider charge stops | From the next installment due after the rider ends |

Hypothetical: an Ashgrove Level Term 10 issued on 1 May 2016 holds its rate through the anniversary year ending 30 April 2026; the rate is re-set from the anniversary of 1 May 2026 and on each anniversary after it.
